Monitoring: Aphids are soft-bodied pear- shaped < ½ cm long insects that can have wings or no wings.
They can be beige, brownish, greenish.
GPS, GIS, RS analyses are used to monitor and predict adult aphids.
Also suction traps are used (Farmer can get information from plant protection station on wheat aphid flight); Use yellow traps to capture adult aphids (2-3 traps per mu).
Search and count aphids weekly from wheat seeding growth to milk-ripe stage.
Count on 15 plants each of 3 to 5 spots along “Z”, walk through field.
Action threshold is 3 to 5 aphids per 10 plants on average.
Direct Control: EBF alarm pheromone of aphids over field push out aphids and to attract natural enemies.
